arguments.text: Thank you, Marisol—it means a lot to have someone checking on our wellbeing. I must admit, today has been quite overwhelming for me; there’s just so much we need to tackle and understand about this world of Fenra. But enough about that…
Before we dive back into planning or tasks, let us take a moment to share something real about ourselves with the group. Dash, Orin, Priya… anyone else?
